title: Rubric Calibration
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting rubric calibration to the calibrated analytic rubric with scored-draft reconciliation log (before/after agreement, traced split, rewritten descriptor), reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Diagnose why a rubric descriptor produces inter-rater disagreement by distinguishing adjective descriptors from observable, countable anchors.
Reconcile a rater split by tracing it to a feature of the work rather than averaging the scores.
Rewrite a level descriptor into a countable observation and verify the gain by re-scoring drafts and re-checking exact agreement.
Apply the new-rater test to judge whether reported agreement is calibration or convergence by habit.
